slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Shoulders and neck feeling it after the first few surfs of summer? 🏄

Most of surfing is paddling. That's hundreds of strokes per session with your neck extended to look ahead, which is a big jump after a quiet winter.

A few things tend to help. Build session length up over a few weeks rather than going straight to three-hour mornings. Add band external rotations, rows and face-down Y raises on land two or three times a week. And give your neck a short rest between sets.

Pain that wakes you at night, weakness lifting your arm or pins and needles down the arm are worth getting assessed. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can build a plan around your surf days. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
